run_textcaps_evaluation: run the TextCaps evaluation script with a predictions JSON file and annotation file
run_coco_caption_eval: run COCO caption evaluation metrics on image predictions and ground truth annotations
calculate_bleu_meteor_rouge: calculate Bleu, METEOR, ROUGE_L, SPICE, and CIDEr metrics for caption evaluation
evaluate_textcaps_train_set: evaluate captioning model predictions against the TextCaps train set annotations
evaluate_textcaps_val_set: evaluate captioning model predictions against the TextCaps val set annotations
